nodes.name: Normalize and Validate Affected Cases Request

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS exception_id,
        LEAST(GREATEST($2::INTEGER, 1), 5)
            AS options_per_patient,
        LEAST(GREATEST($3::INTEGER, 1), 60)
            AS search_days
),

exception_context AS (
    SELECT
        se.id AS exception_id,
        se.clinic_id,
        se.doctor_id,
        se.starts_at AS exception_starts_at,
        se.ends_at AS exception_ends_at,
        se.reason AS exception_reason,
        se.source AS exception_source,

        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,

        r.options_per_patient,
        r.search_days

    FROM schedule_exceptions se

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.exception_id = se.id

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.id = se.clinic_id
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = se.doctor_id
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    WHERE se.is_active = TRUE
      AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

    LIMIT 1
),

affected_appointments AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.clinic_id,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.patient_id,
        a.service_id,
        a.starts_at AS original_starts_at,
        a.ends_at AS original_ends_at,
        a.status AS appointment_status,
        a.visit_reason,
        a.google_calendar_event_id,

        ec.exception_id,
        ec.exception_starts_at,
        ec.exception_ends_at,
        ec.exception_reason,
        ec.clinic_name,
        ec.timezone,
        ec.doctor_name,
        ec.options_per_patient,
        ec.search_days,

        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile,

        s.name AS service_name,
        s.duration_minutes,

        d.buffer_minutes

    FROM appointments a

    INNER JOIN exception_context ec
        ON ec.clinic_id = a.clinic_id
       AND ec.doctor_id = a.doctor_id

    INNER JOIN patients p
        ON p.id = a.patient_id

    INNER JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id
       AND s.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id

    WHERE a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND a.starts_at < ec.exception_ends_at
      AND a.ends_at > ec.exception_starts_at
),

candidate_dates AS (
    SELECT
        aa.*,
        generated_day::DATE AS candidate_date

    FROM affected_appointments aa

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        GREATEST(
            (
                aa.exception_ends_at
                AT TIME ZONE aa.timezone
            )::DATE,
            (
                NOW()
                AT TIME ZONE aa.timezone
            )::DATE
        ),

        GREATEST(
            (
                aa.exception_ends_at
                AT TIME ZONE aa.timezone
            )::DATE,
            (
                NOW()
                AT TIME ZONE aa.timezone
            )::DATE
        )
        + aa.search_days,

        INTERVAL '1 day'
    ) AS generated_day
),

generated_slots AS (
    SELECT
        cd.*,

        slot.slot_start_local,

        slot.slot_start_local
            AT TIME ZONE cd.timezone
            AS candidate_starts_at,

        (
            slot.slot_start_local
            + make_interval(mins => cd.duration_minutes)
        ) AT TIME ZONE cd.timezone
            AS candidate_ends_at

    FROM candidate_dates cd

    INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
        ON ds.doctor_id = cd.doctor_id
       AND ds.is_active = TRUE
       AND ds.weekday =
            EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM cd.candidate_date)::INTEGER
       AND (
            ds.valid_from IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_from <= cd.candidate_date
       )
       AND (
            ds.valid_to IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_to >= cd.candidate_date
       )

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        cd.candidate_date + ds.start_time,

        cd.candidate_date
            + ds.end_time
            - make_interval(mins => cd.duration_minutes),

        make_interval(
            mins => cd.duration_minutes + cd.buffer_minutes
        )
    ) AS slot(slot_start_local)
),

available_slots AS (
    SELECT
        gs.*

    FROM generated_slots gs

    WHERE gs.candidate_starts_at > NOW()
      AND gs.candidate_starts_at >= gs.exception_ends_at

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM schedule_exceptions se

          WHERE se.doctor_id = gs.doctor_id
            AND se.is_active = TRUE
            AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

            AND se.starts_at < gs.candidate_ends_at
            AND se.ends_at > gs.candidate_starts_at
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointments existing

          WHERE existing.doctor_id = gs.doctor_id
            AND existing.id <> gs.appointment_id
            AND existing.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')

            AND existing.starts_at < gs.candidate_ends_at
            AND existing.ends_at > gs.candidate_starts_at
      )
),

ranked_slots AS (
    SELECT
        available.*,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY available.appointment_id
            ORDER BY available.candidate_starts_at
        ) AS slot_rank

    FROM available_slots available
),

limited_slots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_slots
    WHERE slot_rank <= options_per_patient
),

slot_summary AS (
    SELECT
        appointment_id,

        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS proposed_slot_count,

        JSONB_AGG(
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'option_number', slot_rank,
                'appointment_date',
                    TO_CHAR(
                        candidate_starts_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                        'YYYY-MM-DD'
                    ),
                'start_time',
                    TO_CHAR(
                        candidate_starts_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                        'HH24:MI'
                    ),
                'end_time',
                    TO_CHAR(
                        candidate_ends_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                        'HH24:MI'
                    ),
                'starts_at', candidate_starts_at,
                'ends_at', candidate_ends_at
            )
            ORDER BY candidate_starts_at
        ) AS proposed_slots

    FROM limited_slots

    GROUP BY appointment_id
),

prepared_cases AS (
    INSERT INTO appointment_disruption_cases (
        exception_id,
        appointment_id,
        status,
        proposed_slots,
        updated_at
    )

    SELECT
        aa.exception_id,
        aa.appointment_id,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(ss.proposed_slot_count, 0) > 0
                THEN 'awaiting_reschedule_consent'
            ELSE 'awaiting_waitlist_consent'
        END,

        COALESCE(
            ss.proposed_slots,
            '[]'::JSONB
        ),

        NOW()

    FROM affected_appointments aa

    LEFT JOIN slot_summary ss
        ON ss.appointment_id = aa.appointment_id

    ON CONFLICT (exception_id, appointment_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN appointment_disruption_cases.status IN (
                'rescheduled',
                'cancelled',
                'waitlisted',
                'declined',
                'closed'
            )
                THEN appointment_disruption_cases.status
            ELSE EXCLUDED.status
        END,

        proposed_slots = CASE
            WHEN appointment_disruption_cases.status IN (
                'rescheduled',
                'cancelled',
                'waitlisted',
                'declined',
                'closed'
            )
                THEN appointment_disruption_cases.proposed_slots
            ELSE EXCLUDED.proposed_slots
        END,

        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING
        id AS disruption_case_id,
        exception_id,
        appointment_id,
        status AS case_status,
        proposed_slots,
        patient_decision,
        created_at,
        updated_at
),

case_details AS (
    SELECT
        pc.disruption_case_id,
        pc.exception_id,
        pc.appointment_id,
        pc.case_status,
        pc.proposed_slots,
        JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(pc.proposed_slots)
            AS proposed_slot_count,

        aa.patient_name,
        aa.mobile,
        aa.doctor_name,
        aa.service_name,
        aa.appointment_status,
        aa.visit_reason,
        aa.google_calendar_event_id,
        aa.timezone,

        aa.original_starts_at,
        aa.original_ends_at,

        CASE
            WHEN JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(pc.proposed_slots) > 0
                THEN 'offer_reschedule_options'
            ELSE 'request_waitlist_consent'
        END AS next_action

    FROM prepared_cases pc

    INNER JOIN affected_appointments aa
        ON aa.appointment_id = pc.appointment_id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exception_context)
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exception_context)
            THEN 'schedule_exception_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affected_appointments)
            THEN 'no_affected_appointments'
        ELSE 'affected_cases_prepared'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exception_context)
            THEN 'بازه مسدود فعال مطابق شناسه واردشده پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM affected_appointments)
            THEN 'هیچ نوبت فعال تحت‌تأثیر این تغییر برنامه قرار ندارد.'
        ELSE 'پرونده‌های نوبت‌های تحت‌تأثیر و گزینه‌های جایگزین آماده شدند.'
    END AS message,

    r.exception_id,

    (
        SELECT clinic_name
        FROM exception_context
    ) AS clinic_name,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM exception_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT exception_reason
        FROM exception_context
    ) AS exception_reason,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            exception_starts_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM exception_context
    ) AS blocked_start,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            exception_ends_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM exception_context
    ) AS blocked_end,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM case_details
    ) AS disruption_case_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'disruption_case_id',
                        disruption_case_id,
                    'appointment_id',
                        appointment_id,
                    'patient_name',
                        patient_name,
                    'mobile',
                        mobile,
                    'doctor_name',
                        doctor_name,
                    'service_name',
                        service_name,
                    'original_appointment_date',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            original_starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'YYYY-MM-DD'
                        ),
                    'original_start_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            original_starts_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),
                    'original_end_time',
                        TO_CHAR(
                            original_ends_at
                            AT TIME ZONE timezone,
                            'HH24:MI'
                        ),
                    'appointment_status',
                        appointment_status,
                    'case_status',
                        case_status,
                    'proposed_slot_count',
                        proposed_slot_count,
                    'proposed_slots',
                        proposed_slots,
                    'next_action',
                        next_action
                )
                ORDER BY original_starts_at
            )
            FROM case_details
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS disruption_cases

FROM request_data r;

parameters.content:
## آماده‌سازی نوبت‌های تحت‌تأثیر

1. ابتدا Workflow شماره 19 را فقط یک‌بار اجرا کن.

2. `exception_id` را از خروجی Workflow شماره 18 بردار.

3. این Workflow برای هر نوبت تحت‌تأثیر، حداکثر چند زمان جایگزین پیدا می‌کند.

4. هیچ نوبتی در این مرحله خودکار جابه‌جا یا لغو نمی‌شود.

5. اگر زمان جایگزین پیدا نشود، پرونده در وضعیت انتظار برای رضایت ورود به لیست انتظار قرار می‌گیرد.
